```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Données R : cibles {targets} (mêmes calculs que le site et le rapport).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(targets); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2) })
tar_source("R")
theme_set(theme_aei())
options(reactable.language = langue_reactable())
tar_load(c(t1_usage_pays, t2_global, t2_pays, t3_exposition, t4_typologie))
# Dépendance explicite : les Parquet lus par DuckDB-WASM doivent être à jour.
fichiers_publies <- tar_read(donnees_publiees)
pays8 <- names(pays_comparaison())
iso <- requete(tar_read(base_duckdb), "iso_pays")
der <- t1_usage_pays |> filter(release == max(release)) |> filter(date_start == max(date_start))
fr <- der |> filter(geo_id == "FRA")
auto_glob <- t2_global |> filter(source == "claude_ai") |> slice_max(release, n = 1) |>
  slice_max(date_start, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
# Palette transmise au JavaScript : un pays garde sa couleur partout.
ojs_define(palette = as.list(palette_pays()), noms_pays = as.list(pays_comparaison()),
           mode_donnees = mode_execution())
```

## Row {height=78%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Indice d'usage par habitant dans le monde (dernière version)"
# Carte choroplèthe (echarts4r) : noms de pays attendus par la carte « world »
carte <- der |>
  mutate(iso2 = countrycode::countrycode(geo_id, "iso3c", "iso2c", warn = FALSE)) |>
  filter(!is.na(iso2)) |>
  echarts4r::e_country_names(iso2, pays, type = "iso2c") |>
  mutate(aui = round(aui, 2))
carte |>
  echarts4r::e_charts(pays) |>
  echarts4r::e_map(aui, map = "world", name = "Indice par habitant") |>
  echarts4r::e_visual_map(aui, inRange = list(color = rampe_sequentielle()),
                          text = c("élevé", "faible"), calculable = TRUE) |>
  echarts4r::e_tooltip(formatter = htmlwidgets::JS(
    "function(p){ return p.name + ' : ' + (isNaN(p.value) ? 'non publié' : p.value.toLocaleString('fr-FR')); }"))
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Classement (indice par habitant)"
reactable::reactable(
  der |> transmute(Pays = nom_pays(geo_id, iso), Indice = round(aui, 2), `Part de l'usage (%)` = round(usage_pct, 2)) |>
    arrange(desc(Indice)),
  searchable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 12, highlight = TRUE,
  columns = list(`Part de l'usage (%)` = reactable::colDef(format = reactable::colFormat(locales = "fr-FR")),
                 Indice = reactable::colDef(
    cell = reactable::JS("function(cell){ const w = Math.min(100, cell.value * 25);
      return '<div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px\"><div style=\"background:#2a78d6;height:9px;width:' + w + 'px;border-radius:2px\"></div>' + cell.value.toLocaleString('fr-FR') + '</div>'; }"),
    html = TRUE))
)
```

# Pays (interactif)

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Liste SQL des pays choisis. Les codes viennent de la liste proposée (valeurs
// sûres) ; on évite de lier un tableau JS comme paramètre, mal pris en charge
// par certaines versions de DuckDB-WASM.
liste_sql = (codes) => codes.map(c => `'${String(c).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(", ") || "''"
// DuckDB-WASM : une base DuckDB complète, exécutée DANS le navigateur, qui lit
// les fichiers Parquet publiés avec le site. Aucun serveur.
db = DuckDBClient.of({
  usage: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/usage_pays.parquet"),
  automatisation: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/automatisation.parquet"),
  soc: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/soc_pays.parquet"),
  taches: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/taches.parquet"),
  pays: FileAttachment("../donnees_publiees/pays.parquet")
})
versions = (await db.query("SELECT DISTINCT release FROM usage ORDER BY release")).map(d => d.release)
liste_pays = (await db.query(`SELECT DISTINCT u.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, u.geo_id) AS nom
  FROM usage u LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = u.geo_id ORDER BY nom`))
viewof version = Inputs.select(versions, {label: "Version de l'index", value: versions[versions.length - 1]})
viewof choix_pays = Inputs.select(new Map(liste_pays.map(d => [d.nom, d.geo_id])), {
  label: "Pays (Ctrl/Cmd pour plusieurs)", multiple: true, size: 10,
  value: ["FRA", "DEU", "GBR", "ESP", "ITA", "BEL", "NLD", "USA"]
})
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Filtres calculés dans votre navigateur par **DuckDB-WASM** sur les fichiers Parquet du
site. Données d'**usage** de Claude, pas d'emploi.
:::

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Indice d'usage par habitant (version choisie)"
aui = db.query(`SELECT u.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, u.geo_id) AS nom, avg(u.aui) AS aui,
  any_value(u.origine_aui) AS origine
  FROM usage u LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = u.geo_id
  WHERE u.release = ? AND u.geo_id IN (${liste_sql(choix_pays)})
  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY aui DESC`, [version])
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 130, height: Math.max(220, 26 * aui.length), x: {label: "Indice (1 = proportionnel à la population 15–64 ans)", grid: true},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(aui, {y: "nom", x: "aui", sort: {y: "-x"}, rx: 2,
      fill: d => palette[d.geo_id] ?? "#c3c2b7", tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.nom}\nIndice : ${d.aui.toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits: 2})} (${d.origine})`}),
    Plot.ruleX([1], {stroke: "#898781", strokeDasharray: "4,3"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Part d'automatisation (Claude.ai), toutes versions"
auto = db.query(`SELECT a.release, a.geo_id, coalesce(p.country_name, a.geo_id) AS nom,
  avg(a.automatisation_pct) AS auto
  FROM automatisation a LEFT JOIN pays p ON p.iso_alpha_3 = a.geo_id
  WHERE a.source = 'claude_ai' AND a.geo_level = 'country'
    AND a.geo_id IN (${liste_sql(choix_pays)})
  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY a.release`)
Plot.plot({
  height: 320, x: {type: "point", label: "Version"}, y: {label: "Automatisation (%)", grid: true},
  color: {legend: true, domain: [...new Set(auto.map(d => d.nom))],
          range: [...new Set(auto.map(d => d.geo_id))].map(g => palette[g] ?? "#898781")},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(auto, {x: "release", y: "auto", stroke: "nom", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(auto, {x: "release", y: "auto", fill: "nom", r: 4, tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.nom} — ${d.release}\n${d.auto.toLocaleString("fr-FR", {maximumFractionDigits: 1})} %`})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Tâches les plus fréquentes (premier pays sélectionné, version choisie)"
taches = db.query(`SELECT tache, part_pct FROM taches
  WHERE release = ? AND geo_id = ? ORDER BY part_pct DESC LIMIT 15`, [version, choix_pays[0] ?? "FRA"])
Inputs.table(taches, {

})
```

# Automatisation

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Automatisation mondiale par version et par source (survol pour le détail)"
p <- t2_global |>
  filter(date_start == max(date_start) | is.na(date_start), .by = c(release, source)) |>
  mutate(Source = c(claude_ai = "Claude.ai", `1p_api` = "API")[source]) |>
  ggplot(aes(release, automatisation_pct, colour = Source, group = Source,
             text = paste0(Source, " — ", release, "<br>", pct_fr(automatisation_pct)))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Claude.ai` = "#2a78d6", API = "#1baf7a"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Automatisation (%)")
plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |> plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, locale = "fr")
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Pays : automatisation et usage (sélection liée entre tableau et graphique — crosstalk)"
# crosstalk : un même objet partagé alimente le graphique et le tableau ;
# sélectionner des pays dans l'un les met en évidence dans l'autre, sans serveur.
dern <- t2_pays |> filter(release == max(release)) |>
  left_join(t1_usage_pays |> filter(release == max(release), date_start == max(date_start)) |>
              select(geo_id, aui), by = "geo_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(aui)) |>
  mutate(Pays = nom_pays(geo_id, iso), auto = round(automatisation_pct, 1), aui = round(aui, 2))
partage <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(dern, key = ~geo_id)
crosstalk::bscols(
  widths = c(7, 5),
  plotly::plot_ly(partage, x = ~aui, y = ~auto, text = ~Pays, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
                  marker = list(color = "#2a78d6", size = 9), hoverinfo = "text") |>
    plotly::layout(xaxis = list(title = "Indice d'usage par habitant", type = "log"),
                   yaxis = list(title = "Automatisation (%)")) |>
    plotly::highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect", color = "#eb6834") |>
    plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE),
  reactable::reactable(partage, selection = "multiple", onClick = "select", compact = TRUE,
                       searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 10,
                       columns = list(geo_id = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      release = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      date_start = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      automatisation_pct = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      augmentation_pct = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      effectif_classable = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      ic_bas = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      ic_haut = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                                      auto = reactable::colDef(name = "Automatisation (%)"),
                                      aui = reactable::colDef(name = "Indice"))))
```

# Métiers

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Exposition observée de tous les métiers (job_exposure) — métiers budgétaires et financiers en évidence"
expo <- t3_exposition$toutes |>
  mutate(cible = occ_code %in% metiers_cibles()$soc6) |>
  arrange(desc(observed_exposure))
reactable::reactable(
  expo |> transmute(Code = occ_code, Métier = title, Exposition = round(observed_exposure, 3),
                    `Rang centile` = round(100 * centile), cible),
  searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, compact = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 15,
  rowStyle = reactable::JS("function(r){ if (r.row.cible) return {fontWeight: 600, background: 'rgba(42,120,214,.10)'} }"),
  columns = list(cible = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
                 Exposition = reactable::colDef(cell = reactable::JS(
                   "function(c){ return '<div style=\"display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px\"><div style=\"background:#2a78d6;height:9px;width:' + Math.round(c.value*120) + 'px;border-radius:2px\"></div>' + c.value.toLocaleString('fr-FR') + '</div>' }"),
                   html = TRUE))
)
```

# Typologie

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Pays sur le premier plan factoriel (ACP sur les parts CLR des familles de tâches), par classe HCPC"
ind <- tibble::as_tibble(t4_typologie$acp$ind$coord[, 1:2], rownames = "geo_id") |>
  left_join(t4_typologie$croise |> select(geo_id, classe_hcpc, pib_hab_ppa), by = "geo_id") |>
  mutate(Pays = nom_pays(geo_id, iso))
ind |>
  echarts4r::group_by(classe_hcpc) |>
  echarts4r::e_charts(Dim.1) |>
  echarts4r::e_scatter(Dim.2, symbol_size = 11, bind = Pays) |>
  echarts4r::e_color(unname(palette_pays())) |>
  echarts4r::e_tooltip(formatter = htmlwidgets::JS("function(p){ return p.name + ' — classe ' + p.seriesName; }")) |>
  echarts4r::e_x_axis(name = "Axe 1") |> echarts4r::e_y_axis(name = "Axe 2") |>
  echarts4r::e_legend(top = 0)
```
